scoring_method: Each dimension scored 0-100. Weighted sum = total. Confidence levels disclosed per dimension.

dimensions.name: Canais nativos (15%)

chatwoot.rationale: 10 canais nativos incluindo Telegram + TikTok + 3 BSP options WhatsApp; voice e add-on Enterprise; X removido. WhatsApp BYOC (Meta/Twilio/360Dialog) e diferencial real para BR.

zendesk.rationale: 10 canais nativos incluindo Apple Business Chat (raro) + voice Talk first-class; Telegram/TikTok via marketplace. Voice integrado (vs Chatwoot add-on) e o principal advantage.

dimensions.winner_in_dim: Zendesk (margem pequena por Voice + ABC + breadth marketplace)

dimensions.name: AI capability (20%)

chatwoot.rationale: Captain AI nativo (auto-resolve, copilot, smart FAQs, memories, multilingual). Built-in (nao add-on). Trade-off: deflection rate nao publicada, credit consumption rules opacas, maturidade <2 anos vs ecosystem peers.

zendesk.rationale: AI Agents (post-Ultimate.ai) + Copilot + QA AI + WFM. Customer outcomes publicados (Freedom 66%, Next 92%, UrbanStems 39% + $100K, Lush 60% + $434K). Productivity 20% via Copilot. Trade-off: AI Agents per-resolution pricing nao publico; fragmentation pos-aquisicao.

dimensions.winner_in_dim: Zendesk (clear — outcomes publicados + breadth de produtos AI especializados)

chatwoot.rationale: Tiers publicos $0/$19/$39/$99 sem add-ons necessarios. Self-host = $0 license. Sticker-to-real ratio ~1.0-1.2x (Captain credits overage minor). BYOC reduz Meta markup. Predictable.

zendesk.rationale: Pricing $19-$169/agent base + add-ons necessarios (Copilot $50, QA $35, WFM $25, ADPP $50). Real-world multiplier 2-3x. Vendr median deal $47.772/year. Per-tier jumps Team→Growth +62%. AI Agents per-resolution nao publico = forecasting impossible. Pricing BRL publicado e advantage parcial.

dimensions.name: Governance/Compliance (10%)

chatwoot.rationale: GDPR DPA. SOC2 Cloud implicit nao explicit publica. ISO 27001/27018/27701 NAO listados. FedRAMP NAO. HIPAA BAA NAO oferecido. EU residency Cloud nao user-selectable. Audit logs e SSO so Enterprise tier. Self-host e o escape valve real para regulated industries.
chatwoot.confidence: M (absence of public certs is signal but cloud edition may have unpublished posture)

zendesk.rationale: SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001 + ISO 27018 + ISO 27701 + FedRAMP + GDPR Binding Corporate Rules (segunda empresa Irish DPC, 2017) + HIPAA BAA disponivel + Multi-region (US/EU/AU/JP). Caveat: Data Center Location addon Pro/Enterprise REQUER ativacao manual via support (default = data movel sem aviso).

dimensions.winner_in_dim: Zendesk (clear, gap substancial para regulated industries)

dimensions.name: Ecosystem/Marketplace/integrations (10%)

chatwoot.rationale: Tens of named integrations (Slack, Shopify, Dialogflow, MS Teams, WordPress, migration tools, custom). API REST + webhooks aberto. Self-hosted = arbitrary DB integration. Sem marketplace curado pra non-technical buyers. Compensa em flexibilidade tecnica.

zendesk.rationale: 1.977 apps de 1.136 vendors. 75% ARR impacted by marketplace. 58% customers tem 1+ app. AI 21.54% (~425 apps). Categories productivity/analytics/marketing/CRMs/IT/AI. Sandbox environment Enterprise. Maior ecosystem do segmento.

dimensions.winner_in_dim: Zendesk (clear, network effects do marketplace sao um moat real)

dimensions.name: Comunidade/Suporte/Maturidade (10%)

chatwoot.rationale: GitHub 29.1k stars + 7.2k forks (transparente). G2 rating 4.4/5 (review count modesto ~200-400). 9 anos. Monthly minor releases. Community ethos. Trade-off: review universe menor para validation enterprise.

zendesk.rationale: G2 4.3/5 com 6.000+ reviews. Market share 14.80% categoria customer experience (lider). 19 anos. 88% reviewers cite ease of use. 76% adoption long-term. 17 meses estimated payback. BR sales/support team. Enterprise scale proven.

dimensions.winner_in_dim: Zendesk (clear em escala, mas Chatwoot tem vantagem de transparencia GitHub)

chatwoot.rationale: MIT self-hosted full source no feature gating. Deploy options: Docker Compose, K8s, Heroku, Cloud SaaS. WhatsApp BYOC 3 BSP options. API REST + webhooks + DB access self-host. Forks legitimos (MIT). Vendor lock-in MINIMAL — pode migrar self-host a qualquer momento. Zero equivalente no Zendesk.

zendesk.rationale: SaaS proprietary cloud-only. Self-host IMPOSSIBLE. Sandbox environment Enterprise tier (positivo). Apps via Zendesk Apps Framework custom. Vendor lock-in MAXIMUM. Customization ceiling alto via apps mas sempre dentro do guardrails Zendesk.

dimensions.name: Brasil-fit (10%)

chatwoot.rationale: BYOC permite wrap BR BSP (Take Blip, Zenvia) via Cloud API. PT-BR UI mature. Shopify nativa. Sem BRL pricing publicado. Sem VTEX nativa. Sem RD Station nativa. Sem Pix. Sem local support BR team. Sem BR sales team. Self-host BR = $0 e advantage real para PMEs.

zendesk.rationale: Pricing BRL publicado (R$135/R$359/R$755/R$1.105). Suporte PT-BR oficial. Sales BR oficial. Marketplace BR community-built apps (RD Station integration). Caveats: pricing BRL absoluto e proibitivo para PME (R$359 = 5x Octadesk R$79). Sem VTEX nativa, sem Pix nativa.

dimensions.winner_in_dim: Zendesk (turnkey BR; Chatwoot mais flexivel mas menos turnkey)

totals.interpretation: Empate tecnico (delta 0.2 pts em escala 100). Confirma 'no-clear-winner' — escolha depende de contexto especifico do consumidor.

scenario_mid_market_20_agents_with_some_.winner: Empate (depends on internal DevOps capacity vs procurement preference SaaS)

scenario_enterprise_50_agents_regulated_.note: EXCETO se cliente self-host Chatwoot Enterprise edition com paid support; ai equipara em flexibilidade

scenario_br_pme_e_commerce.winner: Chatwoot (Octadesk/Take Blip/Zenvia podem ser superiores ainda — ver pares 2/3)

confidence_summary: H (high) for 5/8 dimensions; M (medium) for C2 (AI per-resolution opacity), C4 (compliance absence inferred), C6 (Chatwoot G2 count estimated). No L (low) confidence dimensions.
